name: IntelliChristian Ads, Affiliate Program
author: DJ Alex

sections.installation:
1. Search for IntelliChristian Ads in the WordPress plugin directory and install.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Settings can be configured under the ‘Settings’ tab in your dashboard.

Support can be found at https://intellichristian.com/intelliadswordpressplugin
sections.description:
IntelliChristian! Affiliate program ads

This plugin adds a banner at the top of your posts with affiliate product ads from IntelliChristian.

You will need to create an account at https://intellichristian.com/affiliateprogram, to get your affiliate ID, so you could get paid for your referrals.

Any questions or problems with the plugin? Visit https://intellichristian.com/intelliadswordpressplugin for support
